shortEffect.en: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

flavorText.es: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.
flavorText.en: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

shortEffect.en: Protects against critical hits.

flavorText.es: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
flavorText.en: Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

shortEffect.en: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

flavorText.es: Evita que el rival pueda debilitarlo de un solo golpe cuando tiene los PS al máximo. También evita los movimientos fulminantes.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

shortEffect.en: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la humedad del entorno y evita que se puedan utilizar movimientos explosivos, tales como Autodestrucción.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

shortEffect.en: Prevents paralysis.

flavorText.es: Evita ser paralizado gracias a la flexibilidad de su cuerpo.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

shortEffect.en: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

flavorText.es: Aumenta su Evasión durante las tormentas de arena.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

flavorText.es: La electricidad estática que lo envuelve puede paralizar al mínimo contacto.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

shortEffect.en: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

flavorText.es: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
flavorText.en: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

shortEffect.en: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

flavorText.es: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua, recupera PS en vez de sufrir daño.
flavorText.en: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

shortEffect.en: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

flavorText.es: Su indiferencia evita que sea provocado o caiga presa del enamoramiento.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

shortEffect.en: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

flavorText.es: Anula todos los efectos del tiempo atmosférico.
flavorText.en: Eliminates the effects of weather.

shortEffect.en: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

shortEffect.en: Prevents sleep.

flavorText.es: Su resistencia al sueño le impide quedarse dormido.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

shortEffect.en: Prevents poison.

flavorText.es: Su sistema inmunitario evita el envenenamiento.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

shortEffect.en: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

flavorText.es: Si le alcanza algún movimiento de tipo Fuego, potencia sus propios movimientos de dicho tipo.
flavorText.en: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

shortEffect.en: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

flavorText.es: El polvo de escamas que lo envuelve lo protege de los efectos secundarios de los ataques recibidos.
flavorText.en: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

shortEffect.en: Prevents confusion.

flavorText.es: Como le gusta hacer las cosas a su manera, los rivales no logran confundirlo.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

shortEffect.en: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Al entrar en combate amilana al rival de tal manera que su Ataque disminuye.
flavorText.en: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

shortEffect.en: Evades Ground moves.

flavorText.es: Su capacidad de flotar sobre el suelo le proporciona inmunidad frente a los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
flavorText.en: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

flavorText.es: Puede dormir, envenenar o paralizar al Pokémon con el que entre en contacto al recibir un ataque.
flavorText.en: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

shortEffect.en: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

flavorText.es: Contagia el envenenamiento, las quemaduras o la parálisis al Pokémon que le cause ese estado.
flavorText.en: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

shortEffect.en: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
flavorText.en: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

shortEffect.en: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

flavorText.es: Cura sus problemas de estado al cambiarse con otro Pokémon.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

shortEffect.en: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

flavorText.es: Atrae y neutraliza los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico, que además le suben el Ataque Especial.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

shortEffect.en: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la probabilidad de que los movimientos causen efectos secundarios.
flavorText.en: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

shortEffect.en: Doubles Speed during rain.

flavorText.es: Sube su Velocidad cuando llueve.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

shortEffect.en: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.

flavorText.es: Sube su Velocidad cuando hace sol.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

shortEffect.en: Doubles the wild encounter rate.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon al iluminar el entorno.
flavorText.en: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

shortEffect.en: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
flavorText.en: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

flavorText.es: Puede envenenar al mínimo contacto.
flavorText.en: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

shortEffect.en: Prevents flinching.

flavorText.es: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

shortEffect.en: Prevents burns.

flavorText.es: Evita las quemaduras gracias a la capa de agua que lo envuelve.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

shortEffect.en: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

flavorText.es: Su magnetismo atrae a los Pokémon de tipo Acero y les impide huir.
flavorText.en: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

shortEffect.en: Protects against sound-based moves.

flavorText.es: Su aislamiento acústico lo protege de movimientos que usan sonido.
flavorText.en: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

shortEffect.en: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

flavorText.es: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando llueve.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

shortEffect.en: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

flavorText.es: Presiona al rival para que sus PP se acaben antes.
flavorText.en: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

shortEffect.en: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

flavorText.es: Gracias a la gruesa capa de grasa que lo protege, reduce a la mitad el daño que recibe de ataques de tipo Fuego o Hielo.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

shortEffect.en: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

flavorText.es: Si se duerme, tardará la mitad de tiempo en despertarse.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

flavorText.es: Puede quemar al mínimo contacto.
flavorText.en: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

shortEffect.en: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

flavorText.es: Puede escaparse de todos los Pokémon salvajes.
flavorText.en: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.

flavorText.es: Su aguda vista evita que le disminuya la Precisión.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

shortEffect.en: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Evita que el rival le baje el Ataque.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

shortEffect.en: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

flavorText.es: Puede recoger objetos que el rival haya usado, o bien otros que encuentre en plena aventura.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

flavorText.es: Aumenta su Ataque, pero reduce su Precisión.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

flavorText.es: Puede causar enamoramiento al rival que lo toque.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon may infatuate attackers that make direct contact with it.

shortEffect.en: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Los objetos se quedan pegados a su cuerpo, por lo que no pueden robárselos.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

flavorText.es: Puede curar sus problemas de estado al mudar la piel.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

shortEffect.en: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

flavorText.es: Si sufre un problema de estado, se viene arriba y aumenta su Ataque.
flavorText.en: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

shortEffect.en: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

flavorText.es: Sube su Defensa si sufre un problema de estado.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.

shortEffect.en: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

flavorText.es: Exuda una sustancia tóxica de intenso hedor que hiere a quienes intentan drenarle PS.
flavorText.en: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

flavorText.es: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
flavorText.en: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

flavorText.es: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
flavorText.en: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

flavorText.es: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
flavorText.en: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

flavorText.es: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Bicho cuando le quedan pocos PS.
flavorText.en: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

shortEffect.en: Protects against recoil damage.

flavorText.es: No puede dañarse con sus propios movimientos.
flavorText.en: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

shortEffect.en: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Cuando entra en combate, el tiempo pasa a ser soleado.
flavorText.en: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle.

shortEffect.en: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

flavorText.es: Evita que el rival huya.
flavorText.en: Prevents opposing Pokémon from fleeing from battle.

shortEffect.en: Prevents sleep.

flavorText.es: Su determinación le impide quedarse dormido.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

shortEffect.en: Protects against critical hits.

flavorText.es: La robusta coraza que lo protege bloquea los golpes críticos.
flavorText.en: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

shortEffect.en: Doubles evasion when confused.

flavorText.es: Sube su Evasión si está confuso.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

shortEffect.en: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

flavorText.es: Si el objetivo es del mismo sexo, su competitividad le lleva a infligir más daño. Si es del sexo contrario, en cambio, el daño será menor.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.

shortEffect.en: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

flavorText.es: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.

shortEffect.en: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

flavorText.es: Sube la Evasión cuando graniza.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

shortEffect.en: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

flavorText.es: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, engulle la baya que normalmente solo se comería cuando le quedasen pocos PS.
flavorText.en: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.

shortEffect.en: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

flavorText.es: Si recibe un golpe crítico, monta en cólera y sube su Ataque hasta el máximo.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

shortEffect.en: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

flavorText.es: Sube su Velocidad si usa o pierde el objeto que lleva.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

shortEffect.en: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

flavorText.es: Pierde PS si hace sol y los recupera si llueve o recibe un movimiento de tipo Agua. Los movimientos de tipo Fuego, por su parte, le hacen más daño de lo normal.
flavorText.en: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

shortEffect.en: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Compara la Defensa y la Defensa Especial del rival para ver cuál es inferior y aumenta su propio Ataque o Ataque Especial según sea lo más eficaz.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon compares an opposing Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever will be more effective.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la potencia de los puñetazos.
flavorText.en: Powers up punching moves.

shortEffect.en: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

flavorText.es: Potencia aún más los movimientos cuyo tipo coincida con el suyo.
flavorText.en: Powers up moves of the same type as the Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

flavorText.es: Ejecuta siempre los movimientos múltiples con el número máximo de golpes.
flavorText.en: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.

shortEffect.en: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

flavorText.es: Cura los problemas de estado si está lloviendo.
flavorText.en: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

shortEffect.en: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

flavorText.es: Si hace sol, aumenta su Ataque Especial, pero pierde PS en cada turno.
flavorText.en: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

shortEffect.en: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la Velocidad si sufre problemas de estado.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

flavorText.es: Potencia los golpes críticos que asesta aún más de lo normal.
flavorText.en: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

shortEffect.en: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

flavorText.es: Solo recibe daño de ataques.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

shortEffect.en: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

flavorText.es: Al quedar ambos expuestos, tanto sus movimientos como los del rival acertarán siempre.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

flavorText.es: Potencia sus movimientos más débiles.
flavorText.en: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

shortEffect.en: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

flavorText.es: Evita los problemas de estado si hace sol.
flavorText.en: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

shortEffect.en: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

flavorText.es: Las habilidades del objetivo no afectan a los movimientos que emplea.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

shortEffect.en: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

flavorText.es: Daña al agresor que le ha dado el golpe de gracia con un movimiento de contacto.
flavorText.en: Damages the attacker if it knocks out the Pokémon with a move that makes direct contact.

shortEffect.en: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

flavorText.es: Prevé los movimientos peligrosos del rival.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

shortEffect.en: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Indica el movimiento más potente del rival al entrar en combate.
flavorText.en: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.

shortEffect.en: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

flavorText.es: Pasa por alto las mejoras en las características del rival al atacar.
flavorText.en: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.

shortEffect.en: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

flavorText.es: Potencia los movimientos que no son muy eficaces, que infligen ahora un daño normal.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.

shortEffect.en: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

flavorText.es: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
flavorText.en: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Puede alcanzar a Pokémon de tipo Fantasma con movimientos de tipo Normal o Lucha.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

shortEffect.en: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

flavorText.es: Recupera PS de forma gradual cuando hay tormentas de granizo.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

shortEffect.en: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Puede ver el objeto que lleva el rival al entrar en combate.
flavorText.en: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

flavorText.es: Potencia los movimientos que también dañan al usuario.
flavorText.en: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

flavorText.es: Sube la potencia de sus movimientos en detrimento de los efectos secundarios, que se ven anulados.
flavorText.en: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

shortEffect.en: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

flavorText.es: Pone nervioso al rival y le impide usar bayas.
flavorText.en: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.

shortEffect.en: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

flavorText.es: Sube mucho su Ataque cuando el rival le baja las características.
flavorText.en: If the Pokémon has any stat lowered by an opposing Pokémon, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Puede anular el movimiento usado en su contra.
flavorText.en: May disable a move that has dealt damage to the Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

flavorText.es: A veces cura los problemas de estado de un aliado.
flavorText.en: Sometimes cures the status conditions of the Pokémon's allies.

shortEffect.en: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

flavorText.es: Reduce el daño que sufren los aliados.
flavorText.en: Reduces damage dealt to allies.

shortEffect.en: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

flavorText.es: Al recibir daño de un ataque físico, le baja la Defensa, pero le sube mucho la Velocidad.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.

shortEffect.en: Halves damage taken from full HP.

flavorText.es: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
flavorText.en: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

shortEffect.en: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

flavorText.es: Puede reutilizar varias veces una misma baya.
flavorText.en: May create another Berry after one is used.

shortEffect.en: Protects against damage from weather.

flavorText.es: No le afectan las tormentas de arena, el granizo y los movimientos con polvos.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

shortEffect.en: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

flavorText.es: Puede envenenar al objetivo con solo tocarlo.
flavorText.en: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.

shortEffect.en: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

flavorText.es: Recupera unos pocos PS al ser cambiado por otro Pokémon.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.

shortEffect.en: Protects against Defense drops.

flavorText.es: Impide que el rival le baje la Defensa.
flavorText.en: Prevents the Pokémon from having its Defense stat lowered.

shortEffect.en: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

flavorText.es: Aumenta su Velocidad durante las tormentas de arena.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

shortEffect.en: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

flavorText.es: Presenta una mayor resistencia ante los movimientos de estado.
flavorText.en: Makes status moves more likely to miss the Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

flavorText.es: Aumenta la potencia de su movimiento si es el último en atacar.
flavorText.en: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

shortEffect.en: Transforms upon entering battle.

flavorText.es: Se transforma en el Pokémon que tiene enfrente.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon transforms itself into the Pokémon it's facing.

shortEffect.en: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

flavorText.es: Ataca sorteando la barrera o el sustituto del rival.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the target's barriers, substitutes, and the like.

shortEffect.en: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

flavorText.es: Al debilitar a un objetivo, su confianza se refuerza de tal manera que aumenta su Ataque.
flavorText.en: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

shortEffect.en: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

flavorText.es: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, aumenta el Ataque debido a su integridad.
flavorText.en: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

shortEffect.en: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

flavorText.es: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, el miedo hace que le suba la Velocidad.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

shortEffect.en: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

flavorText.es: Puede devolver los movimientos de estado lanzados por el rival, sin verse afectado por ellos.
flavorText.en: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

shortEffect.en: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

flavorText.es: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra, Acero y Roca durante las tormentas de arena.
flavorText.en: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.

shortEffect.en: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

flavorText.es: Aumenta mucho su Ataque Especial cuando el rival le baja cualquiera de sus características.
flavorText.en: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

shortEffect.en: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

flavorText.es: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
flavorText.en: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
